title: c2.vip.set
description: Flags a unit as a VIP (high-value unit) or clears the flag. On a managed side, idle fighters orbit it, ships take station and threats to it get priority (24 rows 21-23). Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

unit.description: unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

vip.description: true to flag, false to clear
